cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Leads manufacturing engineering activities of laser powder bed fusion machine development, manufacturing, and operations to meet cost, throughput, and quality targets in partnership with the Additive Technologies machine development team.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve clear and comprehensive work instructions for internal and external assembly and manufacturing processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure work instructions align with production goals and quality standards.
Work closely with design teams to provide input on manufacturability during the product development phases.
Identify and implement design improvements to improve efficiency of manufacturing processes.
Conduct DFM analyses to optimize production costs and cycle times.
Address and resolve issues related to machine build processes.

Implement preventative maintenance programs to minimize machine downtime.
Lead first-pass RCCA activities to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent the recurrence of these issues.

Support supplier technical issues.
Design and optimize factory layouts to maximize workflow efficiency, improve productivity, and ensure safety.

Minimum Requirements
Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar
5+ Years of manufacturing engineering experience
3D CAD modeling and drawing creation
GD&T and tolerance stack-up
Work instruction creation
Manufacturing process development
Factory layout
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
Team collaboration with internal and external partners / stakeholders
Preferred Requirements
Experience in LBPF or industrial capital equipment
Experience in development through production lifecycle
Supplier and production bring-up
Experience using PLM systems
Hands-on skills in basic fabrication or assembly
Highly adaptable and resilient

The [Product name masked] is a complete software hardware solution designed to replace traditional vehicle manufacturing. To make the complex simple, it is a complete modular digital factory for complex structures. Given a set of digital requirements as input, the machine automatically computationally engineers, additively manufactures, and assembles any complex structure. The system is able to move seamlessly between manufacturing different vehicle models.
Leads manufacturing engineering activities of laser powder bed fusion machine development, manufacturing, and operations to meet cost, throughput, and quality targets in partnership with the Additive Technologies machine development team.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve clear and comprehensive work instructions for internal and external assembly and manufacturing processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure work instructions align with production goals and quality standards
Work closely with design teams to provide input on manufacturability during the product development phases.
Identify and implement design improvements to improve efficiency of manufacturing processes.
Conduct DFM analyses to optimize production costs and cycle times.
Address and resolve issues related to machine build processes.
Collaborate with the machine development team to improve machine reliability and performance.
Implement preventative maintenance programs to minimize machine downtime.
Lead first-pass RCCA activities to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent the recurrence of these issues.
Evaluate, design, and optimize assembly fixtures and equipment to improve efficiency and product quality.
Support supplier technical issues.
Design and optimize factory layouts to maximize workflow efficiency, improve productivity, and ensure safety.
cond_0012.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some background in LBPF or industrial capital equipment; experience in development through production lifecycle is a plus.
Working knowledge of 3D CAD modeling and drawing creation.
Familiarity with supplier and production bring-up.
Exposure to GD&T and tolerance stack-up.
Experience with work instruction creation.
Background in manufacturing process development.
Familiarity with factory layout planning.
Experience with PLM systems, or willingness to build that knowledge on the job.
Hands-on skills in basic fabrication or assembly.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Openness to working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Willingness to adapt and learn as priorities shift.
Ability to work well with internal and external partners and stakeholders.

3D CAD modeling and drawing creation

The [Product name masked] is a complete software hardware solution designed to replace traditional vehicle manufacturing. To make the complex simple, it is a complete modular digital factory for complex structures. Given a set of digital requirements as input, the machine automatically computationally engineers, additively manufactures, and assembles any complex structure. The system is able to move seamlessly between manufacturing different vehicle models.
Leads manufacturing engineering activities of laser powder bed fusion machine development, manufacturing, and operations to meet cost, throughput, and quality targets in partnership with the Additive Technologies machine development team.
cond_0587.responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve clear and comprehensive work instructions for internal and external assembly and manufacturing processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure work instructions align with production goals and quality standards.

Identify and implement design improvements to improve efficiency of manufacturing processes.
Conduct DFM analyses to optimize production costs and cycle times.
Address and resolve issues related to machine build processes.

Implement preventative maintenance programs to minimize machine downtime.
Lead first-pass RCCA activities to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent the recurrence of these issues.

Support supplier technical issues.
Design and optimize factory layouts to maximize workflow efficiency, improve productivity, and ensure safety.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in manufacturing engineering.
Deep knowledge of LBPF or industrial capital equipment.

Extensive experience in supplier and production bring-up.
Advanced knowledge of GD&T and tolerance stack-up.
Expertise in work instruction creation.
Substantial expertise in manufacturing process development.
Strong command of factory layout planning.
Proficiency in PLM systems.
Solid hands-on skills in basic fabrication or assembly.
Exceptional adaptability and resilience.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Strong ability to collaborate with internal and external partners and stakeholders.

[Company name masked] has invented a complete manufacturing solution to address system level challenges. The [Product name masked] is a complete software hardware solution designed to replace traditional vehicle manufacturing. To make the complex simple, it is a complete modular digital factory for complex structures. Given a set of digital requirements as input, the machine automatically computationally engineers, additively manufactures, and assembles any complex structure. The system is able to move seamlessly between manufacturing different vehicle models.
Leads manufacturing engineering activities of laser powder bed fusion machine development, manufacturing, and operations to meet cost, throughput, and quality targets in partnership with the Additive Technologies machine development team.
cond_0624.responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve clear and comprehensive work instructions for internal and external assembly and manufacturing processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure work instructions align with production goals and quality standards
Work closely with design teams to provide input on manufacturability during the product development phases.
Identify and implement design improvements to improve efficiency of manufacturing processes.
Conduct DFM analyses to optimize production costs and cycle times.
Address and resolve issues related to machine build processes.
Collaborate with the machine development team to improve machine reliability and performance.
Implement preventative maintenance programs to minimize machine downtime.
Lead first-pass RCCA activities to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent the recurrence of these issues.
Evaluate, design, and optimize assembly fixtures and equipment to improve efficiency and product quality.
Support supplier technical issues.
Design and optimize factory layouts to maximize workflow efficiency, improve productivity, and ensure safety.
cond_0624.requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some background in LBPF or industrial capital equipment; experience in development through production lifecycle is a plus.
Working knowledge of 3D CAD modeling and drawing creation.
Familiarity with supplier and production bring-up.
Exposure to GD&T and tolerance stack-up.
Experience with work instruction creation.
Background in manufacturing process development.
Familiarity with factory layout planning.
Experience with PLM systems, or willingness to build that knowledge on the job.
Hands-on skills in basic fabrication or assembly.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Openness to working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
Willingness to adapt and learn as priorities shift.
Ability to work well with internal and external partners and stakeholders.
